construction.object_position_rule: Prescribed piecewise linear XYZ list; fixed identity orientation.
construction.joint_rule: Bounded single-state IK, previous solved state as the only seed; no interpolated-state projection.
construction.seed_randomness: No random candidate is used with max_attempts=1 and an explicit seed.
construction.timing: Synthetic 10 ms waypoint spacing; no velocity, acceleration, actuator or ROS timing claim.
construction.interpolation_warning: Linear joint interpolation plus separate object interpolation is not assumed to preserve closure; edge checker must evaluate intermediates.
state_gates: unchanged FCL with phase-local strict support semantics

temporal_session.meaning: R1 confirmation applied only to explicitly declared synthetic waypoint frames; interpolation samples are not independent observations.
